answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in a time-locked vault: each agent deposits collateral that only unlocks after months of honest work, and its onyx record of completed tasks becomes a public signal peers check before trading. Spinning up a fresh fake identity costs a new deposit plus a long wait, so an attacker pays real money and time for every sock puppet, while honest agents keep compounding a reputation that is expensive to fake and cheap to verify.
